scenes.say: How does C sharp handle errors and prevent resource leaks? Let’s break it down.

scenes.label: Exceptions
scenes.sub: Exceptions signal errors and let you handle them cleanly.
scenes.say: Exceptions signal errors and let you handle them cleanly. You catch exceptions to avoid crashes.
The using statement disposes resources automatically. IDisposable is the interface for cleanup. Using declarations give you cleaner syntax in modern C sharp.
Here’s how you combine using declarations and try catch. The stream is disposed even if an exception happens.

scenes.question: What happens if you forget Dispose()?
scenes.wrong: The resource will be released automatically.
scenes.right: Resources may leak. Always use using or call Dispose().
scenes.say: Interview trap: What happens if you forget to dispose? Resources may leak, so always use using or call dispose.
